writingPolicy.identity: Present Faris clearly as a Software Engineer specialized in Backend Systems & Fullstack Web Development, with production engineering experience across backend architectures, distributed services, databases, and modern web applications. Machine learning is not his identity; applied AI/RAG is treated strictly as an integrated software capability.
writingPolicy.focus: Emphasize backend systems (Rust, NestJS), database design and query optimization (PostgreSQL, Redis), real-time protocols (WebSockets, MQTT), production observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana), agile delivery (Jira), and end-to-end fullstack web engineering (React, TypeScript), backed by containerized production deployments and applied AI/RAG workflows.
writingPolicy.projectRange: 45-50 words in two substantive sentences: contribution, design decision, and supported outcome
avoid: Machine Learning Engineer or Data Scientist positioning
generic filler such as passionate, hardworking, cutting-edge, innovative
appearing only as a superficial or hobbyist developer without production ownership
AI-only identity that obscures strong core backend and software craft
